correctness.rationale: For fixed radius \(c\), scale reduction gives the exact standardized density \(g_\varepsilon(z)=\varphi(z)(1+\varepsilon z)^{-3/2}\exp(z^2/2-z^2/[2(1+\varepsilon z)])\), analytic uniformly on \([-c,c]\) for small \(\varepsilon\). Its reflection identity makes the central integral even. Exact formal expansion and Gaussian polynomial antiderivatives give the displayed order-\(\kappa^{-1}\) and order-\(\kappa^{-2}\) coefficients, with analytic remainder \(O_c(\kappa^{-3})\). The sign conclusions follow directly, including the negative second-order term at \(c=\sqrt5\).
